name: Data and ML
summary: Plan data preparation, feature work, modelling, evaluation, and monitoring workflows with clear acceptance checks.

phases.label: Problem framing
phases.exit: Objective, target definition, baseline metric, and data access rules are documented.

phases.label: Data
phases.exit: Source datasets are profiled, cleaned, split without leakage, and versioned.

phases.label: Modelling
phases.exit: Candidate models and features are trained reproducibly against the baseline.

phases.label: Evaluation
phases.exit: Holdout metrics, error slices, and bias checks pass acceptance thresholds.

phases.label: Deployment and monitoring
phases.exit: Inference pipeline is verified in production with drift and alert thresholds active.

task_types.label: Dataset
micro_hints: Profile raw columns, missing rates, and label balance
Filter corrupt records and document row count changes
Create leakage-free train, validation, and test splits

task_types.label: Feature
micro_hints: Implement transformation using only training-split statistics
Verify output distributions and null handling on sample rows
Add unit test confirming identical offline and serving values

task_types.label: Experiment
micro_hints: Fix random seeds and record exact hyperparameters used
Train candidate model and log validation metric delta
Record decision and reason in experiment memory section

task_types.label: Evaluation
micro_hints: Compute primary and secondary metrics on untouched holdout split
Measure error rates across key subgroups for fairness checks
Verify latency and memory footprint meet serving limits

task_types.label: Pipeline
micro_hints: Run end-to-end pipeline dry run on fixture input data
Add schema validation and failure alerts at stage boundaries
Configure drift checks and rollback trigger on live metrics

granularity.rule: Each microtask must produce one verifiable artifact, metric, or check result.

memory_sections.label: Data sources and licences
memory_sections.hint: List dataset origins, versions, access dates, and licence or usage restrictions.

memory_sections.label: Metrics and baselines
memory_sections.hint: Record metric definitions, baseline scores, and target release thresholds.

memory_sections.label: Experiment log decisions
memory_sections.hint: Summarize tested hypotheses, selected approaches, and rejected alternatives.

memory_sections.label: Risks and bias
memory_sections.hint: Document leakage risks, subgroup disparities, failure modes, and mitigations.
